{{Top|leg}}
A '''fusion drill''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and cutting tool. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] used fusion drills to cut into the columns on [[Da Soocha V]] to establish [[Pinnacle Base]].
